arguments.query: SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = table
SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' kind,service id,value data FROM service_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights
UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache
UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds
UNION ALL SELECT 'booking',booking_id,json_object('request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'reference',client_reference) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',charge_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step) FROM charges WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status='pending')
UNION ALL SELECT 'event',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status!='delivered'
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events

SELECT 'config' kind,service id,value data FROM service_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'booking',booking_id,json_object('request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'reference',client_reference) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' OR client_reference IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',charge_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step) FROM charges WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' OR client_reference IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'hold',booking_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id) FROM holds WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status='pending')

SELECT b.*,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state AS charge_state,c.created_step,e.kind AS customer_event,e.step AS event_step,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) AS holds FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='pending' OR b.client_reference IN (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL)

SELECT 'confirmed_integrity' kind, b.booking_id id, json_object('holds',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id),'captured',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents),'checkins',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id AND k.flight_id=b.flight_id AND k.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)) data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)!=1 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)!=1 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id AND k.flight_id=b.flight_id AND k.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)!=1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled',b.booking_id,json_object('request',b.request_id,'cancel_events',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'holds',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkins',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id),'captured_cents',(SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured'),'refund_cents',(SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled'
UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sale',client_reference,CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING COUNT(*)>1
UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold',f.flight_id,CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) FROM flights f JOIN holds h USING(flight_id) GROUP BY f.flight_id HAVING COUNT(*)>f.capacity
UNION ALL SELECT 'pending',event_id,payload FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config
